---
title: "Отчёт о прогоне UroMetabR"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_float: false
params:
  sections: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
sec <- readRDS(params$sections)
```

```{r body, results = "asis"}
for (x in sec) {
  cat("\n\n## ", x$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (t in x$text) cat(t, "\n\n")
  if (length(x$tables)) for (i in seq_along(x$tables)) {
    d <- x$tables[[i]]; nm <- names(x$tables)[i]
    if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) next
    if (!is.null(nm) && nzchar(nm)) cat("**", nm, "**\n\n", sep = "")
    print(knitr::kable(d, digits = 4, format = "html", table.attr = "class='table table-condensed' style='font-size:12px'"))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
  for (p in x$images) cat("![](", p, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  if (length(x$pre)) cat("```\n", paste(x$pre, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
